cat > /tmp/post.py <<'EOF'
import html, re, subprocess, sys
page = subprocess.run(["curl","-s","http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
form = re.search(r'<form.*?</form>', page).group(0)
args = []
for m in re.finditer(r'<input type="hidden" name="([^"]*)"(?: value="([^"]*)")?/>', form):
    args += ["--form-string", f"{html.unescape(m.group(1))}={html.unescape(m.group(2) or '')}"]
for kv in sys.argv[1:]:
    args += ["--form-string", kv]
out = subprocess.run(["curl","-s","-w","\nSTATUS %{http_code}","-H","Origin: http://localhost:4701","http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact"]+args,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
print(out.splitlines()[-1])
m = re.search(r'<main>.*</main>', out)
print(m.group(0) if m else out[:2000])
EOF
